# FlexVara

> Product information and ordering for FlexVara, a joint wellness dietary supplement from NUVICA Wellness sold as 60 capsules per bottle, two capsules daily. Published for readers in the United States at https://flexvara-us.vercel.app/. Orders complete on the official checkout, with ClickBank as retailer. Last reviewed 16 November 2026.

FlexVara is a capsule supplement with seven ingredients, each published with its own milligram figure rather than hidden inside a proprietary blend: NEM eggshell membrane 500 mg, boswellia extract 150 mg, calcium 75 mg at 6% of the Daily Value, turmeric root extract 50 mg standardised to 95% curcuminoids, ginger root extract 20 mg, hydrolyzed collagen 5 mg and black pepper fruit extract 5 mg, totalling 805 mg of active material. Other ingredients are microcrystalline cellulose, hypromellose for the capsule shell, magnesium stearate and silicon dioxide. The product carries a CONTAINS EGG allergen declaration because the lead ingredient is derived from hen eggshells, and is described as non-GMO and free of dairy, soy and gluten. The suggested serving is two capsules daily with water, so one bottle lasts 30 days, and the maker recommends using it for at least three to six months. Packages cost $69, $59 and $49 per bottle for two, three and six bottles; free US shipping and the bonus newsletter attach to the three and six bottle packages. Every package carries a 90-day money-back guarantee. One payment, no subscription. Sold to adults 18 and over.

The three and six bottle packages include the bonus newsletter. One payment per package, no subscription, 90-day money-back guarantee. ClickBank is the retailer of record. ## Sources cited on this page

- [NIAMS: osteoarthritis research and resources](https://www.niams.nih.gov/health-topics/osteoarthritis/more-info): the US institute for arthritis and musculoskeletal conditions, with plain-language resources.
- [MedlinePlus: osteoarthritis](https://medlineplus.gov/osteoarthritis.html): consumer background on joint conditions, symptoms and what to ask a clinician.
- [NIH Office of Dietary Supplements: calcium](https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/Calcium/): recommended intakes and upper limits for calcium, relevant to the 75 mg in each serving.
- [NIH Office of Dietary Supplements: what you need to know](https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/WYNTK-Consumer/): a plain-language introduction to dietary supplements.
- [NIH LiverTox: turmeric](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK548561/): background on turmeric, including rare reports of liver injury mostly involving high-dose concentrated curcumin products.
- [FDA: dietary supplements](https://www.fda.gov/food/dietary-supplements): how supplements are regulated under food law rather than medicines law in the United States.
- [FTC: health claims](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/advertising-marketing/health-claims): the advertising rules covering health claims for supplements.
